<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Ahnaf Hawlader — Materials Engineering</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400..700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #F6FAFD;
    --bg-alt: #FCF1F6;
    --bg-panel: #FFFFFF;
    --cream: #33324A;
    --cream-dim: #6E7291;
    --marigold: #F49FC6;
    --coral: #FF87B0;
    --teal: #6FC3E8;
    --pink-ink: #C43F82;
    --blue-ink: #2C8FC2;
    --line: rgba(51,50,74,0.10);
    --dot-color: rgba(111,195,232,0.22);
    --nav-bg: rgba(246,250,253,0.86);
    --pill-bg: rgba(51,50,74,0.045);
    --subtle-fill: rgba(51,50,74,0.04);
    --btn-ink: #402244;
    --btn-shadow: rgba(244,159,198,0.45);
    --icon-bg: rgba(111,195,232,0.18);
    --tag-bg: rgba(244,159,198,0.22);
    --radius-blob: 62% 38% 37% 63% / 58% 41% 59% 42%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  }

  /* ---- Dark theme ---- */
  :root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --bg: #1B1830;
    --bg-alt: #241D38;
    --bg-panel: #2A2240;
    --cream: #F3EFFB;
    --cream-dim: #B6AECF;
    --marigold: #F49FC6;
    --coral: #FF8CB4;
    --teal: #7BD1F5;
    --pink-ink: #FF9FCE;
    --blue-ink: #7FD3FA;
    --line: rgba(243,239,251,0.14);
    --dot-color: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
    --nav-bg: rgba(27,24,48,0.86);
    --pill-bg: rgba(243,239,251,0.06);
    --subtle-fill: rgba(243,239,251,0.055);
    --btn-ink: #2E1330;
    --btn-shadow: rgba(244,159,198,0.25);
    --icon-bg: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
    --tag-bg: rgba(244,159,198,0.16);
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]):not([data-theme="aurora"]):not([data-theme="sunset"]):not([data-theme="forest"]) {
      --bg: #1B1830;
      --bg-alt: #241D38;
      --bg-panel: #2A2240;
      --cream: #F3EFFB;
      --cream-dim: #B6AECF;
      --marigold: #F49FC6;
      --coral: #FF8CB4;
      --teal: #7BD1F5;
      --pink-ink: #FF9FCE;
      --blue-ink: #7FD3FA;
      --line: rgba(243,239,251,0.14);
      --dot-color: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
      --nav-bg: rgba(27,24,48,0.86);
      --pill-bg: rgba(243,239,251,0.06);
      --subtle-fill: rgba(243,239,251,0.055);
      --btn-ink: #2E1330;
      --btn-shadow: rgba(244,159,198,0.25);
      --icon-bg: rgba(123,209,245,0.16);
      --tag-bg: rgba(244,159,198,0.16);
    }
  }

  /* ---- Extra color themes ---- */
  :root[data-theme="aurora"] {
    --bg: #0B1F2A; --bg-alt: #0F2A38; --bg-panel: #123244;
    --cream: #E7FBFA; --cream-dim: #9FCBCB;
    --marigold: #7CF5C4; --coral: #4FD8E8; --teal: #8B7CF5;
    --pink-ink: #6FF0C8; --blue-ink: #8FD8F0;
    --line: rgba(231,251,250,0.14); --dot-color: rgba(139,124,245,0.22);
    --nav-bg: rgba(11,31,42,0.86); --pill-bg: rgba(231,251,250,0.06);
    --subtle-fill: rgba(231,251,250,0.055); --btn-ink: #06222A;
    --btn-shadow: rgba(124,245,196,0.3); --icon-bg: rgba(139,124,245,0.2);
    --tag-bg: rgba(124,245,196,0.16);
  }
  :root[data-theme="sunset"] {
    --bg: #2B1220; --bg-alt: #3A1729; --bg-panel: #431B30;
    --cream: #FFF3EA; --cream-dim: #E7B9A9;
    --marigold: #FFB25E; --coral: #FF6F6F; --teal: #FFD36E;
    --pink-ink: #FF8A5B; --blue-ink: #FFD36E;
    --line: rgba(255,243,234,0.14); --dot-color: rgba(255,111,111,0.2);
    --nav-bg: rgba(43,18,32,0.86); --pill-bg: rgba(255,243,234,0.06);
    --subtle-fill: rgba(255,243,234,0.055); --btn-ink: #33110A;
    --btn-shadow: rgba(255,178,94,0.3); --icon-bg: rgba(255,111,111,0.18);
    --tag-bg: rgba(255,178,94,0.18);
  }
  :root[data-theme="forest"] {
    --bg: #101C14; --bg-alt: #16261A; --bg-panel: #1C2F20;
    --cream: #EFF7EC; --cream-dim: #A9C7AA;
    --marigold: #C7E36B; --coral: #6BE3A6; --teal: #6BC7E3;
    --pink-ink: #A6E36B; --blue-ink: #6BE3C7;
    --line: rgba(239,247,236,0.14); --dot-color: rgba(107,227,166,0.2);
    --nav-bg: rgba(16,28,20,0.86); --pill-bg: rgba(239,247,236,0.06);
    --subtle-fill: rgba(239,247,236,0.055); --btn-ink: #0C1A0E;
    --btn-shadow: rgba(199,227,107,0.3); --icon-bg: rgba(107,227,166,0.18);
    --tag-bg: rgba(199,227,107,0.18);
  }

  body { transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease; }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: inherit; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); }
  html, body { height: auto; }

  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--cream);
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    * { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
  }

  a { color: inherit; }

  h1, h2, h3 {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin: 0;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .wrap {
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 28px;
  }

  /* decorative dot texture */
  .dots {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--dot-color) 1.4px, transparent 1.4px);
    background-size: 22px 22px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header.nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    background: var(--nav-bg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav-inner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 16px 28px;
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .nav-name {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 26px;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }
  .nav-links a {
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover, .nav-links a:focus-visible { color: var(--pink-ink); }
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  @media (min-width: 1000px) { .nav-links { display: flex; } }
  .mobile-menu { position: relative; }
  .mobile-menu summary {
    cursor: pointer; list-style: none; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .88rem;
  }
  .mobile-menu summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  .mobile-menu nav {
    position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 12px); right: 0; width: 190px;
    display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 10px; background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.13);
  }
  .mobile-menu a { text-decoration: none; font-size: .9rem; padding: 8px; border-radius: 7px; }
  .mobile-menu a:hover { background: var(--pill-bg); color: var(--pink-ink); }
  @media (min-width: 1000px) { .mobile-menu { display: none; } }
  @media (max-width: 470px) {
    .nav-inner { padding-inline: 16px; }
    .nav-right { gap: 10px; }
    .theme-picker { gap: 4px; }
    .swatch { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
    .nav-name { font-size: .9rem; }
  }

  .nav-right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .theme-toggle {
    position: relative;
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--pill-bg);
    color: var(--cream);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .theme-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--teal); color: var(--blue-ink); }

  .theme-picker { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  .swatch {
    width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; padding: 0; cursor: pointer;
    border: 2px solid var(--line);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sw1), var(--sw2));
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  }
  .swatch:hover { transform: scale(1.15); }
  .swatch.active { border-color: var(--cream); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg); }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 64px 0 80px;
  }
  .hero-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 44px;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }
  @media (min-width: 860px) {
    .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr; gap: 24px; }
  }
  .eyebrow-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    color: var(--pink-ink);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .eyebrow-line svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.1rem);
    line-height: 1.05;
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .hero h1 em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--pink-ink);
  }
  .hero-sub {
    margin-top: 20px;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    max-width: 46ch;
  }
  .hero-meta {
    margin-top: 26px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 7px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    background: var(--pill-bg);
  }
  .hero-cta {
    margin-top: 34px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 13px 22px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--marigold);
    color: var(--btn-ink);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 24px var(--btn-shadow); }
  .btn-ghost {
    border-color: var(--line);
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--teal); color: var(--blue-ink); }

  .photo-frame {
    position: relative;
    justify-self: center;
    width: min(340px, 78vw);
  }
  .blob-bg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -18px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--coral), var(--marigold));
    border-radius: var(--radius-blob);
    animation: morph 14s ease-in-out infinite;
    opacity: 0.9;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .photo-frame img {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    display: block;
    object-fit: cover;
    aspect-ratio: 3/4;
    border-radius: var(--radius-blob);
    animation: morph 14s ease-in-out infinite;
    border: 4px solid var(--bg);
  }
  @keyframes morph {
    0%, 100% { border-radius: 62% 38% 37% 63% / 58% 41% 59% 42%; }
    33% { border-radius: 45% 55% 62% 38% / 40% 62% 38% 60%; }
    66% { border-radius: 55% 45% 40% 60% / 55% 35% 65% 45%; }
  }

  /* ---------- SECTION SHARED ---------- */
  section { position: relative; padding: 76px 0; }
  .section-alt { background: var(--bg-alt); }
  .kicker {
    color: var(--blue-ink);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    display: block;
  }
  .section-head {
    max-width: 640px;
    margin-bottom: 44px;
  }
  .section-head h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3.4vw, 2.4rem);
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .section-head p { color: var(--cream-dim); margin-top: 12px; font-size: 1.02rem; }

  /* ---------- ABOUT ---------- */
  .about-body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 30px;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .about-body { grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr; }
  }
  .about-body p {
    font-size: 1.08rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    margin: 0 0 18px;
  }
  .about-body p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .about-card {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 26px;
    align-self: start;
  }
  .about-card h3 {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    color: var(--pink-ink);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .about-card ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .about-card li { margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .about-card li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* ---------- PROJECTS ---------- */
  .project-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 20px;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .project-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  }
  .project-card {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px 24px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
  }
  .project-card:hover { border-color: var(--teal); transform: translateY(-4px); }
  .project-icon {
    width: 42px; height: 42px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: var(--icon-bg);
    color: var(--blue-ink);
  }
  .project-card h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--cream); }
  .project-meta { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--cream-dim); opacity: 0.85; }
  .project-card p { color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.95rem; margin: 0; flex-grow: 1; }
  .tag-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; }
  .tag {
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--tag-bg);
    color: var(--pink-ink);
  }

  /* ---------- TIMELINE ---------- */
  .timeline {
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 28px;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--line);
  }
  .t-item {
    position: relative;
    padding-bottom: 34px;
  }
  .t-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .t-item::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: -34px;
    top: 4px;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--coral);
    border: 3px solid var(--bg);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--coral);
  }
  .t-date { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--blue-ink); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .t-item h3 { font-size: 1.08rem; color: var(--cream); margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .t-org { font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--cream-dim); margin-bottom: 8px; display: block; }
  .t-item p { margin: 0; color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.94rem; }
  .timeline-note {
    margin-top: 30px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
  }
  .timeline-note a { color: var(--blue-ink); text-decoration: underline; }

  /* ---------- SKILLS ---------- */
  .skills-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 22px;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .skills-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  }
  .skill-group {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 24px;
  }
  .skill-group h3 {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--blue-ink);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .skill-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
  .skill-pill {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    padding: 7px 13px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--subtle-fill);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    color: var(--cream);
  }

  /* ---------- EDUCATION / HONORS ---------- */
  .edu-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 24px;
  }
  @media (min-width: 780px) {
    .edu-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; }
  }
  .edu-card {
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 26px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }
  .edu-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .edu-card h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--cream); }
  .edu-when { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--blue-ink); margin: 4px 0 10px; }
  .edu-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.93rem; }
  .honor-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  .honor-list li {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    font-size: 0.93rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
  }
  .honor-list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .honor-list svg { flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--pink-ink); }

  /* ---------- CONTACT ---------- */
  .contact-panel {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-panel), var(--bg-alt));
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 26px;
    padding: 52px 40px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .contact-panel h2 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem); }
  .contact-panel p { color: var(--cream-dim); margin: 14px auto 30px; max-width: 46ch; }
  .contact-cta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; }
  .resume-note {
    margin-top: 22px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    opacity: 0.75;
  }

  footer {
    padding: 30px 0 calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--cream-dim);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  /* ---------- MATCH GAME ---------- */
  .match-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 22px; }
  .match-board {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    max-width: 520px;
    width: 100%;
  }
  @media (min-width: 620px) { .match-board { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } }
  .match-card {
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 3/4;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--bg-panel);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    perspective: 600px;
  }
  .match-face {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 12px;
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.4s ease;
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 6px;
  }
  .match-front { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--coral), var(--marigold)); color: var(--btn-ink); font-size: 1.4rem; transform: rotateY(0deg); }
  .match-back { background: var(--pill-bg); color: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--line); transform: rotateY(180deg); }
  .match-card.flipped .match-front, .match-card.done .match-front { transform: rotateY(-180deg); }
  .match-card.flipped .match-back, .match-card.done .match-back { transform: rotateY(0deg); }
  .match-card.done { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }
  .match-hud { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; color: var(--cream-dim); font-size: 0.92rem; }
  .match-status { color: var(--pink-ink); font-weight: 600; }

  /* ---------- SMALL INTERACTIONS ---------- */
  .scroll-progress {
    position: absolute; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 3px; width: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--coral), var(--teal));
    transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; pointer-events: none;
  }
  .hero-copy { animation: arrive 0.8s ease both; }
  .photo-frame { animation: arrive 0.9s 0.12s ease both, float 6s 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .hero-orbit {
    position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 14px;
    display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(51,50,74,.12);
    font-size: 1.35rem; pointer-events: none;
  }
  .hero-orbit.one { top: -10px; right: -18px; animation: bob 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .hero-orbit.two { bottom: 34px; left: -28px; animation: bob 5s 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .feature-banner {
    margin: 0; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-alt);
    border-block: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .feature-banner img {
    width: 100%; height: clamp(220px, 25vw, 370px); display: block;
    object-fit: cover; object-position: 65% center;
    transition: transform .8s ease;
  }
  .feature-banner:hover img { transform: scale(1.025); }
  .feature-banner figcaption {
    position: absolute; left: max(24px, calc((100vw - 1024px)/2)); bottom: 20px;
    padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 10px; color: #33324A;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  }
  .interest-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
  .interest-card {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 28px 24px;
    background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px;
    transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease;
  }
  .interest-card::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; width: 120px; height: 120px; right: -55px; top: -55px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tag-bg); transition: transform .4s ease;
  }
  .interest-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-.5deg); border-color: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba(51,50,74,.09); }
  .interest-card:hover::after { transform: scale(1.5); }
  .interest-icon { display: block; font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 18px; transition: transform .3s ease; }
  .interest-card:hover .interest-icon { transform: rotate(-12deg) scale(1.15); }
  .interest-card h3 { font-size: 1.18rem; }
  .interest-card p { color: var(--cream-dim); margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: .95rem; }
  .reveal-ready { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); }
  .reveal-ready.revealed { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); transition: opacity .65s ease, transform .65s ease; }
  .match-card.done { animation: match-pop .4s ease; }
  .match-status.celebrate { animation: match-pop .5s ease; }
  @keyframes arrive { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
  @keyframes float { 0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; } 50% { translate: 0 -8px; } }
  @keyframes bob { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-8deg) translateY(0); } 50% { transform: rotate(8deg) translateY(-10px); } }
  @keyframes match-pop { 50% { transform: scale(1.08); } }
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .interest-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .feature-banner img { object-position: 78% center; }
    .feature-banner figcaption { left: 16px; bottom: 14px; font-size: .76rem; }
    .hero-orbit.one { right: -8px; }
    .hero-orbit.two { left: -8px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    .photo-frame, .hero-copy, .hero-orbit { animation: none !important; }
    .reveal-ready { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .feature-banner:hover img, .interest-card:hover, .interest-card:hover .interest-icon { transform: none; }
  }

  ::selection { background: var(--marigold); color: var(--btn-ink); }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--teal);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }
</style>
</head>
